name: @playliquid/package-registry
description: PlayLiquid package registry (PL-011). An immutable, in-memory-first index over package records per spec/package-contract.md: fail-closed publish (mutation of an immutable coordinate is rejected, idempotent republish), deterministic resolution reusing @playliquid/package-system, lookup by identity/digest/capability/permission, stable listing, and the registry-to-CAS wiring that verifies lockfile pins against both the registry and the @playliquid/artifact-store (lock rule 10). Pure domain: no fs, no network — persistence flows through the RegistryStore port.
